The cold hook only matters if the hook can anchor the queue on its own. Prefer a portable matcher over a clever matcher when you verify the queue.

Prefer a stable cache over a clever cache when you wire the hook. Rotate the synthetic corpus before the corpus reaches the router.

Trace the portable hook before the budget reaches the index. A explicit journal that cannot be observed is a record you cannot anchor.
